mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_WRITER_NAME , CREATED_AT FROM BOARDS WHERE DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{pagingCount} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARDS WHERE DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT b.BOARD_ID AS b_board_id, b.BOARD_TITLE AS b_title, b.BOARD_WRITER_NAME AS b_writer_name, b.BOARD_CONTENT AS b_content, b.CREATED_AT AS b_created_at, b.DELETED_AT AS b_deleted_at,
c.COMMENT_ID AS c_comment_id, c.BOARD_ID AS c_board_id, c.COMMENT_WRITER_NAME AS c_writer_name, c.COMMENT_CONTENT AS c_content, c.CREATED_AT AS c_created_at, c.DELETED_AT AS c_deleted_at
FROM BOARDS b
LEFT JOIN COMMENTS c
ON b.BOARD_ID = c.BOARD_ID AND c.DELETED_AT IS NULL
WHERE b.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND b.DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT BOARD_PASSWORD AS password FROM BOARDS WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARDS ( BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_WRITER_NAME, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_PASSWORD, CREATED_AT, DELETED_AT ) VALUES ( #{board.title}, #{board.writerName}, #{board.content}, #{board.password}, sysdate, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARDS SET BOARD_TITLE = #{board.title}, BOARD_WRITER_NAME = #{board.writerName}, BOARD_CONTENT = #{board.content}, BOARD_PASSWORD = #{board.password} WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE BOARDS SET DELETED_AT = sysdate WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
